Bytes retained by the Elite tape's contiguous load and repacked by JCT. The Remember Elite build clears the gap or overlays it with trainer code and text. Resident pointer tracing and JCT load and execute watches corroborate the unused gap.

Tail of the Elite tape's contiguous load after the final sound-effect terminator and following $FF. The Remember Elite build clears this tail. A CPU load watch caught the interpreter branching to cleanup on $BFB2.
Copied tail after the last VIC sprite at $EDFF. Matches the Elite tape's $4000-to-$D000 relocation byte for byte. VIC selectors and the sprite frame directories bound game fetches outside this range.
Copied tail beyond the $F800 screen and its sprite pointers. Matches the Elite tape's $4000-to-$D000 relocation byte for byte. The VIC keeps the screen at $F800 and sprite IDs end at $B7.
